name: Jukebox Custom Disc Fix
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: eclipseisoffline
description: This mod fixes bug MC-260346, which causes custom music discs, when played in a jukebox, to be cut off when the vanilla disc would normally end.
needs: Mixin: 2 points inside the game's methods
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3), Machines (0.4), Mixin (0.5)
